labelHelp.billing: questions or problems about charges, invoices, prices or payment methods, without asking for money back
labelHelp.technical: the app or a feature is broken, slow or erroring
labelHelp.account_access: cannot sign in, passwords, two-factor, email on the account, security
labelHelp.cancellation: wants to stop a subscription or close the account
labelHelp.product_question: questions about plans, features or pricing before buying
labelHelp.feedback: opinions, praise, complaints and suggestions with no request to act

decision.reason: Tuned beats base by 19 of 120 held-out tickets (73% to 89%).

events.text: 240 examples to learn from, 64 checks for tuning, 120 held out for the test. 8 labels.
Running in stub mode: no Token Factory key, answers are simulated.
Base Llama 3.1 8B got 88 of 120 held-out tickets right (73%).
Nemotron 3 Ultra scored 89% at $0.207 per 1,000 calls: the bar to chase.
Nemotron 3 Super found 6 failure types in 25 mistakes on the tuning checks.
Refund asked as a billing complaint: Asks for money back but mentions a charge, so the model says billing.
Cancel read as an account issue: Wants to end the subscription but mentions the account.
product question read as technical: Tickets that are product_question get labelled technical.
billing read as cancellation: Tickets that are billing get labelled cancellation.
Tavily skipped: no TAVILY_API_KEY.
Nemotron 3 Ultra wrote 160 cases; Nemotron 3 Super agreed with 76. 84 dropped.
Uploaded 316 training and 64 validation examples to Token Factory.
Fine-tuning Llama 3.1 8B with LoRA (rank 16, 3 epochs) on Token Factory. Job ftjob-stub-3.
Epoch 1 done: training loss 0.57, validation loss 0.69.
Epoch 2 done: training loss 0.26, validation loss 0.37.
Epoch 3 done: training loss 0.17, validation loss 0.25.
Training finished in 1 min. Validation loss 0.25.
Deploying the adapter as "apprentice-run-002".
Tuned Llama 3.1 8B got 107 of 120 right (89%), up from 73%.
Shipped. Tuned beats base by 19 of 120 held-out tickets (73% to 89%). Endpoint: apprentice-run-002.
